sentences.en: The rocket landed sufficiently gently to avoid breaking its instruments.
sentences.zh: 火箭着陆足够轻柔，以免损坏其仪器。

sentences.en: Hideo turned the steering wheel sharply to avoid the bicyclist.
sentences.zh: Hideyo突然猛打方向盘以避开骑自行车的人。

sentences.en: We have to avoid the nuclear war by all means.
sentences.zh: 我们必须想尽一切办法避免核战争。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：a（加强）+void（空）→空出来→躲开

collocations.en: I must avoid doing such a thing
collocations.zh: 我必须避免做这样的事
